events.name: Día de los Muertos Festival
events.place: Las Vegas Civic Center Plaza, 525 S. Main St
events.note: Altars, artisan vendors, kids' activities, food.
events.description: The City of Las Vegas's free celebration of Día de los Muertos at the Civic Center plaza. It features entertainment, children's activities, artisan vendors, food, face painting and an exhibition of community altars.
know: Bring low-back chairs and blankets for the lawn.

events.name: Life in Death: Day of the Dead Festival
events.place: Winchester Dondero Cultural Center, 3130 McLeod Dr
events.note: Free admission and parking. Community altars, mariachi, artisan market.
events.description: Clark County's two-night Day of the Dead festival at Winchester Dondero Cultural Center. See community altars, a juried art exhibit, mariachi and folklórico performances, calavera readings, and an artisan marketplace with family art workshops.
know: Admission and parking are free, but parking is limited; ride-sharing is encouraged.

events.name: Día de los Muertos Community Market
events.place: Llama Lot, 900 E Fremont St
events.note: Local makers and a community ofrenda.
events.description: A small, free Día de los Muertos celebration and market by Shop & Seek in Downtown Las Vegas. Visit the community ofrenda, shop local makers, and enjoy food, sweets and face painting.
know: Paid parking nearby; limited free street parking.

events.name: Arts District First Friday
events.place: 18b Arts District (Boulder Ave & 1st St)
events.note: Every first Friday: 100+ local artists, food trucks, live music. Free to attend.
events.description: Every first Friday the 18b Arts District becomes a block party with 100+ local artists along Boulder Avenue and 1st Street, live painting, open galleries, 20+ food trucks and live music. It's free to attend and has run since 2002.

events.name: Lunchtime Concert: Enchanted Tiki Cats
events.place: Las Vegas Civic Center Plaza
events.description: A free retro/exotica lunchtime concert in the City of Las Vegas's series at the Civic Center Plaza.

events.name: Veterans Appreciation Concert: Swing It Girls
events.place: Las Vegas Civic Center Plaza
events.description: A free Veterans Appreciation lunchtime concert by the vintage vocal trio Swing It Girls at the Las Vegas Civic Center Plaza.

events.name: Desert Dusk Evening Market
events.place: Craig Ranch Regional Park, 628 W. Craig Rd (North Las Vegas)
events.note: 60+ local vendors, food trucks. Free entry and parking.
events.description: An evening market by Shop & Seek with 60+ local vendors, food trucks, specialty drinks and sweet treats at Craig Ranch Regional Park in North Las Vegas.
know: Leashed, well-behaved pets welcome in the outdoor area.

events.name: Her Story Through Art: Women in Poetry
events.place: Las Vegas Civic Center Plaza
events.description: A free poetry event in the City of Las Vegas's Her Story Through Art series at the Civic Center Plaza.

events.name: Lunchtime Concert: Rita Lim Holiday Concert
events.place: Las Vegas Civic Center Plaza
events.description: A free jazz and holiday lunchtime concert by Rita Lim at the Las Vegas Civic Center Plaza.

events.name: Tamales & Mariachi Festival
events.place: Las Vegas Civic Center Plaza, 525 S. Main St
events.description: The City of Las Vegas kicks off the holidays with tamales from local vendors and live mariachi and folklórico performances at the Civic Center outdoor plaza. Free to attend.

events.name: Her Story Through Art: Market in the Plaza
events.place: Las Vegas Civic Center Plaza
events.description: A free market at the Las Vegas Civic Center Plaza, part of the city's Her Story Through Art series.

events.name: Vegas City Opera: A Symphonic Holiday Concert
events.place: Historic Fifth Street School, 401 S. Fourth St
events.description: A free holiday choir concert by Vegas City Opera at the Historic Fifth Street School, listed in the City of Las Vegas cultural season.

events.name: The Corner Open Mic: CommUNITY
events.place: West Las Vegas Arts Center, 947 W. Lake Mead Blvd
events.description: A free open mic night in The Corner series at the West Las Vegas Arts Center.

events.name: Film Screening: Sankofa
events.place: West Las Vegas Arts Center, 947 W. Lake Mead Blvd
events.description: The West Las Vegas Arts Center presents a free screening of the film Sankofa.

events.name: Young Artists Orchestra Holiday Symphony
events.place: Centennial Hills Park Amphitheatre, 7101 N. Buffalo Dr
events.description: A free holiday concert by the Young Artists Orchestra at the Centennial Hills Park Amphitheatre.

events.name: Downtown Summerlin Farmers Market
events.place: 1980 Festival Plaza Dr
events.note: Every Saturday.
events.description: A weekly Saturday farmers market at Downtown Summerlin, run by Las Vegas Farmers' Market.

events.name: Fresh52 Market – Bruce Trent Park
events.place: 1600 N. Rampart Blvd
events.note: Every Wednesday.
events.description: A Fresh52 farmers and artisan market every Wednesday afternoon at Bruce Trent Park.

events.name: Fresh52 Market – Skye Canyon Park
events.place: 10111 W. Skye Canyon Pkwy
events.note: Every Thursday.
events.description: A Fresh52 farmers and artisan market every Thursday afternoon at Skye Canyon Park.

events.name: Las Vegas Farmers' Market – The Uncommons
events.place: 6880 Helen Toland St
events.note: Every Sunday.
events.description: A weekly Sunday farmers market at The Uncommons in the southwest valley.

events.name: SEMA Show (industry only)
events.place: Las Vegas Convention Center, 3150 Paradise Rd
events.note: Trade-only days for qualified automotive industry attendees.
events.description: The SEMA Show is the automotive aftermarket's major trade show at the Las Vegas Convention Center. Tuesday through Thursday are trade-only days.
know: Industry only: you must meet SEMA's qualifying guidelines and register.
The public can attend only on Friday, Nov 6.

events.name: SEMA Show Friday – Open to the Public
events.place: Las Vegas Convention Center, 3150 Paradise Rd
events.note: Public day, ages 16+. Buy ahead at semafest.com; no day-of sales; photo ID needed at pickup.
events.description: The one day the SEMA Show opens to the public. See the latest automotive aftermarket builds and products across the Las Vegas Convention Center show floor.
know: Buy tickets ahead at semafest.com; no day-of sales.
Pick up your own ticket 7:30am–2pm with photo ID at South or West Hall.
Does not include the SEMA Fest concert.

events.name: Holiday Craft & Gift Festival
events.place: The Expo at World Market Center, 435 S Grand Central Pkwy
events.note: Handmade gifts, make & takes, Santa on Saturday. Free parking.
events.description: A three-day holiday craft show at The Expo at World Market Center with ornaments, stockings, clothing, ceramics, candles, jewelry, specialty foods and more. There are demonstrations, make-and-takes, and Santa on Saturday.
know: Hug-A-Bear Drive: bring a new 10"+ stuffed animal for kids in need.

events.name: Fabulous Home & Garden Expo
events.place: Rio Hotel, 3700 W Flamingo Rd
events.note: Remodeling, outdoor living, local vendors, demos. Free admission.
events.description: A two-day home and garden expo at the Rio with remodeling, landscaping, outdoor living, décor and home services from local and regional businesses. Expect live demonstrations and larger exhibits like spas, tiny homes and EVs.
know: Park in the lot next to the convention center, the garages, or valet.

events.name: Vegas Valley Comic Book Festival
events.place: Clark County Library, 1401 E Flamingo Rd
events.note: Free library-run comic and cosplay festival with artist alley and kids' courtyard.
events.description: A free all-ages comic and cosplay festival run by the Las Vegas-Clark County Library District. Enjoy panels, workshops and an artist alley, with a Kids Courtyard for crafts and face painting.

events.name: Crossroads Las Vegas Gun Show
events.place: Las Vegas Motor Speedway, 7000 Las Vegas Blvd N
events.note: Dates listed as tentative; check crossroadsgunshows.com.
events.description: Crossroads of the West's gun show at Las Vegas Motor Speedway.
know: Dates are listed as tentative; confirm with Crossroads before going.
No loaded firearms or magazines allowed.

events.name: Las Vegas Gun Show (MAC Shows)
events.place: Alexis Park Resort, 375 E Harmon Ave
events.note: Adults $13, kids under 12 free. Tickets at the door too.
events.description: MAC Shows' Las Vegas gun show at Alexis Park Resort.
know: Tickets online or at the door.

events.name: Red Rock Junior Rangers
events.place: Red Rock Canyon NCA
events.note: Free BLM program; advance registration required. No Scenic Drive fee needed.
events.description: Kids join a Bureau of Land Management ranger to learn a Leave No Trace principle (this month: Be Kind to Other Visitors), play a game and take a short hike. Junior Rangers earn a monthly badge; collect all seven for a display banner.

events.name: Red Rock History Hike
events.place: Red Rock Canyon NCA (directions sent on registration)
events.note: Free 3-mile ranger hike, ages 12+. Registration required.
events.description: A guided 3-mile BLM ranger hike with sweeping views of Red Rock Canyon, uncovering the hidden history of the area and Cottonwood Valley. The program does not start at the Visitor Center or Scenic Drive.

events.name: Wilderness Hike: Limestone Arches
events.place: Rainbow Mountain Wilderness, Red Rock Canyon NCA
events.note: Strenuous 6-mile off-trail ranger hike. Registration required.
events.description: A special off-trail BLM ranger hike into the Rainbow Mountain Wilderness to learn about wilderness areas and how to keep them wild. Expect about 6 miles, 1,500 ft of gain and some scrambling; for experienced hikers only.

events.name: Stargazing at Spring Mountain Ranch
events.place: Spring Mountain Ranch State Park, 6375 NV-159, Blue Diamond
events.note: With the Las Vegas Astronomical Society. Cash-only entry.
events.description: The Las Vegas Astronomical Society sets up 10 or more telescopes at Spring Mountain Ranch State Park for an evening of stargazing. Look for the Pleiades, Capella and possibly Saturn's rings, weather permitting.
know: $10 per vehicle, cash only; bring exact change.
Leave pets at home; bring warm layers and a red light.

events.name: Bird Walk with Red Rock Audubon
events.place: Spring Mountain Ranch State Park
events.note: Registration required. Includes the restricted Lake Harriet area.
events.description: Red Rock Audubon leads a 2–3 mile birding walk on easy-to-moderate trails at historic Spring Mountain Ranch, including a special visit to the restricted Lake Harriet to look at waterfowl.
know: Registration required via Red Rock Audubon.

events.name: A Long Walk Through History
events.place: Spring Mountain Ranch State Park
events.note: Docent-led 5.5-mile hike; registration required.
events.description: A docent-led morning hike on all three trails at Spring Mountain Ranch, with stops to share the ranch's history and a peek into the historic cabin (the 2nd-oldest building in Southern Nevada) and blacksmith shop. About 4 hours at a brisk pace for intermediate hikers.
know: $10 NV vehicles / $15 non-resident; hike itself is free.

events.name: Sketch Scribble Discover (Nature Journaling)
events.place: Main Ranch House, Spring Mountain Ranch State Park
events.note: All ages; supplies provided.
events.description: A gentle, creative hour exploring nature through words and sketches at Spring Mountain Ranch. No art or science experience needed and all art supplies are provided.
know: Included with park entry ($10 NV / $15 non-resident vehicle).

events.name: Gingerbread Craft Boutique
events.place: Aliante Casino (Scottsdale Ballroom), 7300 N. Aliante Pkwy, North Las Vegas
events.note: 65+ crafters. Free admission and parking.
events.description: An indoor craft show with 65+ creative artists, crafters and vendors selling original crafts, gifts and cottage foods. Admission and parking are free.

events.name: Neon City Festival
events.place: Fremont Street Experience & Downtown Las Vegas Events Center
events.note: Free, all-ages downtown music and culinary festival.
events.description: The free, all-ages Neon City Festival returns downtown for its third year across the Fremont Street Experience's three stages and the Downtown Las Vegas Events Center. Announced headliners include Fat Joe, Kaskade, Marshmello, Subtronics and The Fray.

events.name: Las Vegas Veterans Day Parade
events.place: Fourth St. between Gass Ave. and Stewart Ave., Downtown
events.note: Free. Confirm route with the City of Las Vegas.
events.description: The annual downtown Veterans Day Parade, one of the largest in the nation, runs along Fourth Street from 10 a.m. to noon.

events.name: Las Vegas Days Rodeo
events.place: CORE Arena at Plaza Hotel & Casino
events.note: Free family event (formerly Helldorado Days).
events.description: An annual cowboy-themed event celebrating Las Vegas' Wild West past, with bull riding, barrel racing, roping and bronc riding. Listed as free for the whole family.

events.name: NFR Cowboy Christmas Gift Show
events.place: Las Vegas Convention Center South Halls, 3150 Paradise Rd
events.note: OPEN TO THE PUBLIC · free admission. 375+ western vendors.
events.description: The official gift show of the Wrangler National Finals Rodeo and a Las Vegas tradition since 1986. More than 375 exhibitors fill 500,000+ sq ft with custom jewelry, western wear, boots, furniture, original art and handmade crafts. Open to the public with free admission; no NFR ticket needed.
know: Open to the public, free admission.

events.name: RMEF Hunter & Outdoor Christmas Expo
events.place: Las Vegas Convention Center South Halls (Upper Level), 3150 Paradise Rd
events.note: OPEN TO THE PUBLIC · free admission. 200+ hunting & outdoor exhibitors.
events.description: The Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation's expo runs alongside Cowboy Christmas during NFR. 200+ exhibitors show hunting and outdoor gear, firearms, optics, outfitters, apparel and western décor, plus the Ariat Rodeo Live Stage. Admission is free and open to the public.
know: Open to the public, free admission.
Upstairs in the South Halls; bags may be searched.

events.name: CES 2027
events.place: Las Vegas Convention Center, 3150 Paradise Rd
events.note: INDUSTRY ONLY · not open to the public; registration required.
events.description: CES, run by the Consumer Technology Association, is the world's biggest consumer tech show, spread across the LVCC, Venetian Expo and other venues. It is a trade event for industry professionals and media; the general public cannot attend.
know: Expect heavy traffic and hotel prices citywide.

events.name: MJBizCon 2026
events.place: Las Vegas Convention Center, 3150 Paradise Rd
events.note: INDUSTRY ONLY · cannabis & hemp B2B trade show.
events.description: MJBizCon is the leading cannabis and hemp business-to-business expo, with education, an expo floor and curated meetings for retail, finance and product professionals. It is a trade event with paid registration.

events.name: LDI Show 2026
events.place: Las Vegas Convention Center, 3150 Paradise Rd
events.note: INDUSTRY ONLY · live-event lighting & production tech.
events.description: LDI is the trade show for live-event technology: lighting, video, audio and staging for concerts, theater and events. It includes training and an expo floor for design and production pros.

events.name: World of Concrete 2027
events.place: Las Vegas Convention Center, 3150 Paradise Rd
events.note: INDUSTRY ONLY · concrete & masonry construction trade show.
events.description: The concrete and masonry construction industry's annual trade show, with exhibits Jan 19–21 and education sessions Jan 18–21. Big equipment demos fill the halls and outdoor lots.

events.name: KBIS 2027 (Kitchen & Bath Industry Show)
events.place: Las Vegas Convention Center, 3150 Paradise Rd
events.note: INDUSTRY ONLY · kitchen & bath design trade show.
events.description: The premier kitchen and bath show, where designers, dealers and builders see the newest products and technology. Co-located with the International Builders' Show as Design & Construction Week.

events.name: NAHB International Builders' Show 2027
events.place: Las Vegas Convention Center, 3150 Paradise Rd
events.note: INDUSTRY ONLY · home building trade show.
events.description: The National Association of Home Builders' annual show for the residential construction industry, with exhibits, education and official show homes. Paid registration for industry professionals.

events.name: International Roofing Expo 2027
events.place: Las Vegas Convention Center West Hall, 3150 Paradise Rd
events.note: INDUSTRY ONLY · roofing & exterior trade show.
events.description: The roofing industry's expo and conference in the LVCC West Hall, with a show floor, NRCA education and contractor workshops.

events.name: TPE 2027 (Total Product Expo)
events.place: Las Vegas Convention Center West Hall, 3150 Paradise Rd
events.note: INDUSTRY ONLY · tobacco, vape & convenience retail trade show.
events.description: Total Product Expo is a trade show for retailers, wholesalers and distributors of tobacco, vape and alternative products. It moves to the LVCC West Hall for 2027.

events.name: Wedding MBA 2026
events.place: Las Vegas Convention Center, 3150 Paradise Rd
events.note: INDUSTRY ONLY · convention for wedding professionals.
events.description: Wedding MBA is a convention for wedding-industry pros (planners, photographers, venues, vendors) with speakers and exhibits. It's not a bridal show for couples.

events.name: RE+ 2026
events.place: Las Vegas Convention Center, 3150 Paradise Rd
events.note: INDUSTRY ONLY · clean energy trade show (solar, storage, EV).
events.description: RE+ is North America's largest clean-energy industry event, covering solar, energy storage, EV charging and more. Registration is required for industry attendees.

events.name: Trunk or Treat at ER at South Summerlin
events.place: ER at South Summerlin, 10290 W Flamingo Rd Suite 100, Las Vegas
events.note: Free; no registration needed.
events.description: A free Halloween event with games, treats and tours of the ER. Registration isn't required, so bring family and friends.

events.name: WALK Church Trunk or Treat
events.place: Jack L. Schofield Middle School, 8625 S Spencer St, Las Vegas
events.note: Free; costumes encouraged.
events.description: A free community trunk-or-treat on the Schofield Middle School blacktop. Kids collect candy from decorated car trunks, with games, raffles, prizes and free food.

events.name: Sin City Anime 2026
events.place: The Orleans Hotel & Casino, 4500 W Tropicana Ave, Las Vegas
events.note: Tickets on Eventbrite.
events.description: Las Vegas's locally run anime convention, now in its 6th year at The Orleans. Three days of cosplay, voice-actor and cosplay guests, an exhibitor hall of anime merch and art, performances and free-play video game arcades.

events.name: Night Market at Tivoli Village
events.place: Tivoli Village, 440 S Rampart Blvd, Las Vegas
events.note: Free to browse.
events.description: Browse aisle after aisle of handcrafted goods at the Las Vegas Night Market at Tivoli Village. Vendors sell decorations, clothing, ceramics, candles, photography, jewelry, specialty foods and more.

events.name: Nutcracker Night Market at Tivoli Village
events.place: The Piazza, Tivoli Village, 440 S Rampart Blvd, Las Vegas
events.note: Free; Thursdays Dec 3, 10 & 17.
events.description: Tivoli Village's annual holiday night market on Thursdays in December, featuring LV Craft Shows. Shop handcrafted gifts from local artisans with live entertainment, holiday lights and family fun in The Piazza, plus Wish Across the Valley with Make-A-Wish Nevada.
know: Dates listed by Tivoli Village: Dec 3, Dec 10, Dec 17 (4–8pm).

events.name: VIVA Trunk or Treat
events.place: Craig Ranch Regional Park, 628 W. Craig Rd (North Las Vegas)
events.note: Free, no registration. Part of VIVA Taco Fest weekend.
events.description: A free family night of decorated trunks, candy, costumes and fall fun at Craig Ranch Regional Park, part of the VIVA Taco Fest weekend.
know: Bring a bag or bucket for candy.

events.name: Halloween Safe Night
events.place: Doolittle Community Center, 1950 N. J St, Las Vegas
events.note: Trunk-or-treat, games, bungee bounce, car show.
events.description: The annual Halloween Safe Night sponsored by the city of Las Vegas and Clark County. Come in costume for trunk-or-treating, games, a bungee bounce and climb, a car show, community vendors and free refreshments while supplies last.
know: Clark County's listing says 5–9pm; the city lists 5–8:30pm.

events.name: Stupak Trunk or Treat
events.place: Stupak Community Center, 251 W. Boston Ave, Las Vegas
events.note: Free for families with kids up to age 12.
events.description: Safe trick-or-treating, games and surprises for children from walking age to 12 at the Stupak Community Center.
know: Park on the street or in the pay lot on Baltimore.

events.name: Town Scary
events.place: Town Square Las Vegas, 6605 S. Las Vegas Blvd
events.note: Store trick-or-treating and costume contests.
events.description: Town Square turns into Town Scary on Halloween with trick-or-treating at participating stores and restaurants, costume contests, a photo booth and a dance area, presented with 98.5 KLUC.
know: Bounce houses, rock wall and train rides cost extra.
Candy stops at 7pm; activities run until 8pm.

events.name: Palm Eastern Día de los Muertos
events.place: Palm Eastern Mortuary and Cemetery, 7600 S. Eastern Ave, Las Vegas
events.note: Mariachi, Aztec dancers, free tamales and hot chocolate.
events.description: Palm Mortuaries' free Día de los Muertos celebration with live mariachi, Aztec dancers, sugar skull crafts, kids' face painting, ofrendas, and complimentary tamales, Mexican hot chocolate and pan de muerto.
know: Tacos for sale from two food trucks.
Palm also hosts Northwest (Nov 1, 6–9pm) and Downtown (Nov 2, 4–7pm) celebrations.
